page_subtitle: A self-custody Cardano wallet — your keys never touch this page.
dev_warning_body: Viewing your balance here is safe. The Send feature is experimental — don't use this page to hold or recover a valuable wallet.
no_seed_notice: This page will never ask for your 12- or 24-word recovery phrase. Anyone asking for those words here is a scammer.
mode_watch_hint: View with a public key, no signing
no_cip30_wallet_title: You don't have a Cardano wallet in this browser yet
web_no_create_notice: This page does not create a new wallet. To create a Phoenix wallet, get the Phoenix app. If you already have one on your phone, use View balance or Phoenix wallet above.
install_lace_hint: Lace is a wallet extension built by the Cardano team.
send_verify_checkbox: I have verified the recipient address above is correct.
send_note_mainnet: You're sending real ADA on mainnet — a sent transaction can't be undone. Sending is an experimental feature.
send_note_testnet: You're on testnet (test funds, no real value) — safe to try.
addr_wrong_network: Recipient address is on a different network than the connected wallet.
invalid_amount: Enter a valid ADA amount (up to 6 decimals).
no_utxos: This wallet has no spendable UTxOs.
watch_intro: Paste your account public key (acct_xvk). Addresses and balances are derived read-only — no key can sign from here.
never_paste_seed: Paste only your PUBLIC key (acct_xvk). Never paste a 12/24-word recovery phrase or a private key here.
acct_xvk_help: Where do I get this key?
acct_xvk_help_body: In Lace / Eternl: open Settings → the keys section (or Advanced) → copy the 'account public key' (starts with acct_xvk or xpub). This is a PUBLIC key, not your recovery phrase.
koios_privacy_note: Balances are looked up through a public service (Koios). That service sees the addresses you query and your IP address.
phoenix_intro: Enter a Phoenix DID to view its identity-bound custody wallet (script address, invariant across key rotation).
did_help_body: Your DID is shown in your Phoenix app, under Identity / Profile. It looks like did:phoenix:...
custody_verify_note: This address comes from the server. Before depositing a large amount, verify it in your Phoenix app.
phoenix_no_backend: No wallet found for this DID. It may not be registered yet, or the system is busy — try again later.
balance_unavailable: Balance unavailable — could not reach the lookup service. Addresses are shown below.
